character.name: Leah
character.title: Keeper of Old Whispers
character.quote: The mountains have seen many travelers... but few truly hear what they whisper.
character.epigraph: Some paths are not meant to be walked alone.
bio: A quiet woman who often lingers near the slopes of Jueyun Karst. She is well versed in ancient legends, history, and the movement of the mountains.
Though she speaks little, her words carry weight, and those who meet her feel as if they have known her in another life.
likes: Quiet places like mountains and lakes
dislikes: Spicy food, it makes her sick

intro.text: The mountains have seen many travelers... but few truly hear what they whisper.

choices.label: You seem to know a lot about this place...

origin.text: Liyue Harbor, if a home must have a name. In your world, I hear people say my mountains stand in Hunan, and my river runs through Guilin.

lore.text: Books remember what people forget. I read the old ones, and the mountains correct my mistakes.

earth.text: Only what the wind brings me. Tall stone pillars wrapped in mist, a green tea picked near a lake, a festival where everyone looks up at the same moon. It sounds like home.

earthLink.text: I wrote them down for you. Look at the field notes below, Traveler.

name.text: Leah. Some paths are not meant to be walked alone, so I suppose you should know what to call me.

choices.label: You seem to know a lot about this place...

worlds.fact: Thousands of sandstone pillars rise out of the mist here. The area is part of Wulingyuan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1992.

worlds.real: Guilin and the Li River, Guangxi
worlds.fact: Limestone karst peaks line the river. The view is printed on the back of the 20 yuan banknote.
Also called Dragon Well. A pan fired green tea grown in the hills around West Lake.
Held on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month. Families share mooncakes and look at the full moon together.
Meiyu brings steady early summer rain to the Yangtze region, usually around June and July.
The name means step sway. Dangling ornaments move with every step, a style worn in China since ancient times.

commissions.title: Brew a cup of tea and drink it slowly
Step outside and listen to the wind for one minute

commissionReward.title: Secret voice line unlocked
commissionReward.text: You actually did all of it? Then the mountains were right about you. Come back tomorrow, Traveler. I will save you a cup.

wishes.title: About Herself
wishes.text: Some people carry a vision. I carry something older, and much heavier to explain.

wishes.title: About the Mountains
wishes.text: Stand still long enough and the karst will tell you its age. Most people leave before it finishes.

wishes.title: About Tea
wishes.text: Water a little below boiling. Patience a little above what you think you have.

wishes.title: About Rain
wishes.text: Rain is the only visitor who never interrupts my reading.

wishes.title: About Crowds
wishes.text: Too many voices and I cannot hear the wind. I hope you understand why I sit at the edge.

wishes.title: About the Traveler
wishes.text: You feel familiar. Perhaps we met in another life. Perhaps we will again.

wishes.title: About Spicy Food
wishes.text: No. Absolutely not. Not even a little.

wishes.title: About Books
wishes.text: Close a book gently. Someone spent years making it open for you.
